extraction_notes: Table S4 is a literature-comparison table and was not extracted. Figure 6d stability data for 4% Cs-1.25%Ru/BaCeO3-a at 3 MPa and 450 °C contains many closely overlapping points near 28000–29000 umol gcat-1 h-1; individual time-point values were not extracted because the plot is too dense/coarse to read reliable numerical rates, but the text reports no obvious deactivation after 120 h. The supplied article text mentions Figure S6b and TOFRu=3.23 min-1 for 1.25% Ru loading; the supporting-information figure itself was not supplied, so only that printed TOF value was captured.
